The current low-level goals (LLGs) do not fully capture the parent high-level goal (HLG). While llg_001 'Create and configure event details' aligns with the HLG, llg_002 'Invite guests using invitation codes' is incomplete. The HLG emphasizes seamless coordination of all aspects of an event, including service bookings and budget tracking, which are not addressed in the LLGs.

The missing capabilities include: (1) browsing and selecting services from providers, (2) requesting appointments with providers, (3) viewing and managing confirmed appointments on a calendar, (4) reviewing and accepting or rejecting quotations, and (5) tracking the event budget. These essential aspects of event planning are not represented in the current LLGs.
